title: The New Covenant Consummated: Revelation
subtitle: Revelation 1-22
theme: The Lamb wins. All God’s covenantal promises find their Yes in Christ. New creation.
memoryText: Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man. He will dwell with them, and they will be his people.
reviewQuestions: How does Revelation draw on imagery from every major section of the OT?
What does it mean that the Lamb who was slain holds the scroll of history?
How does Revelation 21-22 fulfill the promises of Genesis 1-2?
Looking back: where do you see God’s covenant faithfulness from beginning to end?
psalmsNote: Psalms 1, 19, and 29 at the opening. Throne psalms (2, 46, 93, 97) before the bowls. Psalms 72:18-19 and 150 at the close.
